candidate_ideas.statement: Use the relative linear system |omega_C(-D)| over the free balanced tetragonal locus to model the top-dimensional ordered failure locus as a relative P^2 with its discriminant removed.
Prove the complementary locus has Tate lowest-weight cohomology by constructing a precise Casnati-Ekedahl framing and controlling every base, fibre, local system, and splitting-type stratum.
Analyze an admissible-cover compactification and its boundary maps to determine whether the degree-14 lowest-weight cohomology of the balanced tetragonal Hurwitz locus is Tate.
Use a stratified localization or Borel-Moore formalism to assemble contributions from every component and stratum of the evaluation-failure locus.

established_facts.evidence: Substitution into W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}) = W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d), with d=3g-3+n=21, gives 2d-16=26.
established_facts.statement: For M_{6,6} of dimension 21, Poincare duality identifies W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) with W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21).

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 gives deg(W_f)=4g+12-4f, including the negative sign in gamma^*O(-f).
established_facts.statement: Under W_f=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O(-f))|_C, one has deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_4)=20 in genus 6.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004's degree formula gives deg(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma))=-4; a negative-degree line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve has no nonzero global section.
established_facts.statement: For every effective degree-six divisor Gamma, H^0(C,omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma))=0.

established_facts.evidence: The obstruction line bundle has degree zero, and a degree-zero line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve has a nonzero section exactly when it is trivial.
established_facts.statement: For every effective degree-six divisor Gamma, H^0(C,omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) is nonzero exactly when O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.

established_facts.evidence: Relative duality gives O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C = omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2); squaring and tensoring by gamma^*O(-5), with gamma^*O(1)=O_C(D), yields the identities.
established_facts.statement: On a balanced tetragonal genus-six cover with fibre divisor D, W_5 is isomorphic to omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D), so W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} is isomorphic to omega_C(-D).

established_facts.evidence: Combine O_C(Gamma)=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} with W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}=omega_C(-D).
established_facts.statement: The degree-six failure condition on the balanced tetragonal locus is Gamma in |omega_C(-D)|, equivalently D+Gamma is canonical.

established_facts.evidence: Reducedness and pairwise distinctness form the complement of the relative discriminant; the free permutation action on six ordered distinct points has quotient the unordered reduced divisor.
established_facts.statement: The reduced-support locus in a relative degree-six linear system is open, and ordering six distinct support points gives a finite etale S_6-cover.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Finite etale pushforward introduces nontrivial local systems. Monodromy, including braid-group monodromy, can produce non-Tate mixed Hodge structures even when the base has Tate cohomology.
invalid_steps.statement: A finite etale cover of an open subset of M_{0,n} has pure Tate cohomology because the base has pure Tate cohomology.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The field of definition of the deck-group representations does not determine their Hodge type; cohomology with the associated monodromic local systems can be non-Tate.
invalid_steps.statement: Passing to a finite etale S_6-cover changes rational cohomology only by additional Tate summands because all rational S_6-representations are defined over Q.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Unbalanced splitting types, non-reduced divisors, and jumping-linear-system strata remain in the closed locus and may contribute to Borel-Moore homology and boundary maps.
invalid_steps.statement: The closed evaluation-failure locus may be replaced by its balanced reduced-support top stratum in localization.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: That purity-form Gysin map requires suitable smoothness or a regular pure-codimension embedding. For a singular, non-pure stratified locus one must use cohomology with supports or Borel-Moore homology and account separately for all strata.
invalid_steps.statement: A singular stratified closed locus of top codimension four yields the displayed ordinary-cohomology Gysin sequence H^{18}(Z)(-4) to H^{26}(M).

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Dimension alone does not eliminate their appropriately shifted cohomology or the connecting and residue maps in a stratification spectral sequence.
invalid_steps.statement: Positive-codimension strata cannot contribute to the weight-26 degree-26 term solely because they have smaller dimension.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The discriminant complement has additional cohomology and monodromy; the projective-bundle formula applies to the full projective bundle, not automatically to its open discriminant complement.
invalid_steps.statement: Removing the discriminant from a P^2-bundle leaves only the projective-bundle cohomology relevant to the lowest-weight calculation.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: An open subset of an affine space or stack is generally only quasi-affine; affineness and the asserted cohomological-dimension bound require separate justification.
invalid_steps.statement: An open subset of an affine stack is automatically affine, so its cohomology vanishes above the dimension of the ambient affine stack.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Even weight permits non-diagonal Hodge types (p,q) with p+q even; eliminating them requires an actual calculation of monodromy, invariants, and boundary maps.
invalid_steps.statement: Even total weight forces every contributing positive-genus factor to have Hodge type (p,p).

reusable_computations.statement: For g=6 and n=6, d=3g-3+n=21 and 2d-16=26.
Using deg(W_f)=4g+12-4f at g=6 gives deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_4)=20.
For a degree-six divisor Gamma, 4f+n-2g-14 equals -4 for f=4 and 0 for f=5.
For L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, deg(L)=6 and chi(L)=deg(L)-g+1=1.
Simple degree-four ramification in genus 6 has total degree 2g-2-4(-2)=18, and dim M_{0,18}=15.
A relative P^2 over a 15-dimensional base has dimension 17, hence codimension 4 in a 21-dimensional ambient space.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Determine all balanced and unbalanced components of the closed evaluation-failure locus, their dimensions, intersections, stabilizers, and maps to tetragonal moduli.
Prove the required cohomological statement for every non-reduced-support and h^0-jumping stratum.
Compute the monodromy local systems arising from the Hurwitz branch cover and determine their degree-14 lowest-weight Hodge structures.
Provide a valid localization formalism for the singular stratified support and track all weight shifts and boundary maps into degree 26.
Establish that the complementary open contributes only Q(-13), including the effects of finite covers, configuration-space discriminants, and unbalanced splitting types.
Determine whether any non-Tate summand from the support strata survives in W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q).
